name: AuditWriter

input_contract.recorded_at_utc: assigned by AuditWriter from canonical UTC whole-second clock at insertion preparation; caller does not supply arbitrary recording time

validation_order: action_type + action_version resolve exact static payload contract
reason category validates against action contract when required
payload passes StrictVersionedJson and action-specific closed allowlist
sensitivity classifier confirms prohibited fields/content categories absent
resolve default or exact action/schema/version payload-byte and result-ref allocations from ../bounds.json; unlisted tuples receive only the defaults
resulting event references are exact type+identity pairs and do not exceed the resolved result-ref limit
canonical stored payload is serialized with allow_nan=false and its UTF-8 bytes are rechecked against the resolved exact payload limit
insert_order_inside_uow: command_receipt inserted for the accepted command
plain INSERT audit_event_results in deterministic ordinal order
error_policy: duplicate audit identity -> AUDIT_DUPLICATE_ID integrity failure
any required audit failure aborts/rolls back the owning authoritative command
append_only_enforcement: migrations verify trigger identities/behavior before readiness
ordinary cleanup/retention/job code has no audit deletion capability
correction_rule: correction/reversal/deletion records use a new audit_event_id and minimal payload referencing exact prior identity/action/evidence as allowed; prior audit row/payload is never edited
payload_byte_limit: Resolve the Foundation default or exact action/schema/version byte allocation from ../bounds.json, then enforce the smaller of that Foundation ceiling and the registered packet payload-contract ceiling. A packet may be stricter but can never widen Foundation locally. Recheck canonical serialized UTF-8 bytes against the same effective limit; do not apply the ordinary default after an authorized exact exception.
payload_registry_ownership: LLD-01 defines validator/registry mechanics; each domain LLD must register its action payload schemas before that command can be implementation-ready
result_ref_limit: Resolve the Foundation default or exact action/schema/version result-ref allocation from ../bounds.json. Packet code may emit fewer refs but can never widen Foundation locally. Payload-embedded typed refs remain governed by the exact payload schema/collection bounds and do not become audit_event_results automatically.
